other_conditions: Own agricultural land in the applicant's own name
If applicant belongs to an undivided family, the applicant's name must appear in the revenue record
For tractor‑operated implements, the tractor must be registered in the applicant's name
Applicant must not have received a grant for the same type of agricultural implement in the last three years
Applicant must not have received grants for more than three different types of agricultural implements in a financial year
Equipment must be purchased from an authorized dealer
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of up to 40% of the equipment price (subject to maximum monetary limits) to eligible farmers purchasing agricultural machinery.
